# Purpose

This report quantifies how ACORN-SAT homogenisation changes the statistical behaviour of Australian daily maximum and minimum temperature. The comparison uses the ACORN-SAT v2.3 raw primary-site composite and the corresponding published v2.3.0 homogenised daily series.

The adjustment convention is

$$
A^{\max}_{s,t}=T^{\max,\mathrm{hom}}_{s,t}-T^{\max,\mathrm{raw}}_{s,t},
$$

and analogously for minimum temperature. Positive values indicate that the homogenised observation is warmer than the raw primary-site observation.

The analysis is deliberately paired by ACORN location and date. Results describing adjustments use only dates on which both raw and homogenised values are available for the relevant variable.

# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(data.table)
library(arrow)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# Determine project root.
# Quarto may execute this document from either the project root
# or the analysis directory.
project_root <- if (file.exists("_targets.R")) {
  "."
} else if (file.exists("../_targets.R")) {
  ".."
} else {
  stop("Could not locate project root containing _targets.R.", call. = FALSE)
}

comparison_file <- file.path(
  project_root,
  "data-derived",
  "acorn",
  "comparison",
  "acorn_raw_homogenised_comparison_v2.3.parquet"
)

homogenised_file <- file.path(
  project_root,
  "data-derived",
  "acorn",
  "homogenised",
  "acorn_homogenised_daily_v2.3.0.parquet"
)

raw_file <- file.path(project_root,
                      "data-derived",
                      "acorn",
                      "acorn_raw_composite_v2.3.parquet")

required_files <- c(comparison_file, homogenised_file, raw_file)

missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]

if (length(missing_files) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Required derived files are missing:\n",
    paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n"),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

comparison <- data.table::as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(comparison_file))

homogenised <- data.table::as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(homogenised_file))

raw_composite <- data.table::as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(raw_file))

setorder(comparison, acorn_station_number, date)
comparison[, year := as.integer(format(date, "%Y"))]
comparison[, month := as.integer(format(date, "%m"))]
comparison[, season := factor(
  fifelse(month %in% c(12L, 1L, 2L), "DJF",
  fifelse(month %in% 3:5, "MAM",
  fifelse(month %in% 6:8, "JJA", "SON"))),
  levels = c("DJF", "MAM", "JJA", "SON")
)]

matched_tmax <- comparison[matched_tmax == TRUE]
matched_tmin <- comparison[matched_tmin == TRUE]

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 11))
```

# Data integrity and overlap

## Network and period

```{r}
#| label: network-summary

network_summary <- data.table(
  dataset = c("Raw composite", "Homogenised", "Paired comparison"),
  rows = c(nrow(raw_composite), nrow(homogenised), nrow(comparison)),
  stations = c(
    uniqueN(raw_composite$acorn_station_number),
    uniqueN(homogenised$acorn_station_number),
    uniqueN(comparison$acorn_station_number)

  first_date = c(
    min(raw_composite$date, na.rm = TRUE),
    min(homogenised$date, na.rm = TRUE),
    min(comparison$date, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  last_date = c(
    max(raw_composite$date, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(homogenised$date, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(comparison$date, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)
```

```{r}
  first_date = min(date),
```

# Distribution of daily adjustments

## Network-wide summaries

```{r}
#| label: adjustment-summary

adjustment_summary <- rbindlist(list(
  matched_tmax[, .(
    variable = "Tmax",
    n = .N,
    mean = mean(tmax_adjustment),
    sd = sd(tmax_adjustment),
    minimum = min(tmax_adjustment),
    q01 = quantile(tmax_adjustment, 0.01),
    q25 = quantile(tmax_adjustment, 0.25),
    median = median(tmax_adjustment),
    q75 = quantile(tmax_adjustment, 0.75),
    q99 = quantile(tmax_adjustment, 0.99),
    maximum = max(tmax_adjustment),
    proportion_unchanged = mean(abs(tmax_adjustment) < 1e-10)
  )],
  matched_tmin[, .(
    variable = "Tmin",
    n = .N,
    mean = mean(tmin_adjustment),
    sd = sd(tmin_adjustment),
    minimum = min(tmin_adjustment),
    q01 = quantile(tmin_adjustment, 0.01),
    q25 = quantile(tmin_adjustment, 0.25),
    median = median(tmin_adjustment),
    q75 = quantile(tmin_adjustment, 0.75),
    q99 = quantile(tmin_adjustment, 0.99),
    maximum = max(tmin_adjustment),
    proportion_unchanged = mean(abs(tmin_adjustment) < 1e-10)
  )]
))

adjustment_summary
```

## Histograms

The full distributions contain a small number of very large adjustments. The main histograms therefore show the central 99.8% of values, while the complete extremes are tabulated separately.

```{r}
#| label: adjustment-histograms
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4.5

plot_tmax <- matched_tmax[
  between(tmax_adjustment,
          quantile(tmax_adjustment, 0.001),
          quantile(tmax_adjustment, 0.999))
]

plot_tmin <- matched_tmin[
  between(tmin_adjustment,
          quantile(tmin_adjustment, 0.001),
          quantile(tmin_adjustment, 0.999))
]

p1 <- ggplot(plot_tmax, aes(tmax_adjustment)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1, boundary = 0, colour = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Tmax adjustment",
    subtitle = "Central 99.8% of matched observations",
    x = "Homogenised minus raw (°C)", y = "Station-days"
  )

p2 <- ggplot(plot_tmin, aes(tmin_adjustment)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1, boundary = 0, colour = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Tmin adjustment",
    subtitle = "Central 99.8% of matched observations",
    x = "Homogenised minus raw (°C)", y = "Station-days"
  )

if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
  p1 + p2
} else {
  print(p1)
  print(p2)
}
```

# Does adjustment depend on raw temperature?

Raw temperatures are classified within station and calendar month so that tropical, temperate and alpine sites are compared on a locally meaningful scale.

```{r}
#| label: raw-temperature-quantiles

matched_tmax[, raw_percentile := frank(tmax_raw, ties.method = "average") / .N,
             by = .(acorn_station_number, month)]
matched_tmin[, raw_percentile := frank(tmin_raw, ties.method = "average") / .N,
             by = .(acorn_station_number, month)]

matched_tmax[, temperature_band := cut(
  raw_percentile,
  breaks = c(0, .01, .05, .25, .75, .95, .99, 1),
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  labels = c("0–1%", "1–5%", "5–25%", "25–75%", "75–95%", "95–99%", "99–100%")
)]

matched_tmin[, temperature_band := cut(
  raw_percentile,
  breaks = c(0, .01, .05, .25, .75, .95, .99, 1),
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  labels = c("0–1%", "1–5%", "5–25%", "25–75%", "75–95%", "95–99%", "99–100%")
)]

adjustment_by_raw_quantile <- rbindlist(list(
  matched_tmax[, .(
    variable = "Tmax",
    n = .N,
    mean_adjustment = mean(tmax_adjustment),
    median_adjustment = median(tmax_adjustment),
    mean_absolute_adjustment = mean(abs(tmax_adjustment)),
    p95_absolute_adjustment = quantile(abs(tmax_adjustment), 0.95)
  ), by = temperature_band],
  matched_tmin[, .(
    variable = "Tmin",
    n = .N,
    mean_adjustment = mean(tmin_adjustment),
    median_adjustment = median(tmin_adjustment),
    mean_absolute_adjustment = mean(abs(tmin_adjustment)),
    p95_absolute_adjustment = quantile(abs(tmin_adjustment), 0.95)
  ), by = temperature_band]
))

adjustment_by_raw_quantile
```

```{r}
#| label: adjustment-tail-plot
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5

ggplot(adjustment_by_raw_quantile,
       aes(temperature_band, mean_absolute_adjustment,
           colour = variable, group = variable)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Adjustment magnitude across the raw temperature distribution",
    x = "Within-station, calendar-month raw temperature percentile band",
    y = "Mean absolute adjustment (°C)", colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

# Annual extremes and records

## Annual extreme statistics

```{r}
#| label: annual-extremes

annual_extremes <- comparison[, .(
  raw_annual_max_tmax = if (all(is.na(tmax_raw))) NA_real_ else max(tmax_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
  hom_annual_max_tmax = if (all(is.na(tmax_hom))) NA_real_ else max(tmax_hom, na.rm = TRUE),
  raw_annual_min_tmin = if (all(is.na(tmin_raw))) NA_real_ else min(tmin_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
  hom_annual_min_tmin = if (all(is.na(tmin_hom))) NA_real_ else min(tmin_hom, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_raw_tmax = sum(!is.na(tmax_raw)),
  n_hom_tmax = sum(!is.na(tmax_hom)),
  n_raw_tmin = sum(!is.na(tmin_raw)),
  n_hom_tmin = sum(!is.na(tmin_hom))
), by = .(acorn_station_number, station_name, year)]

annual_extremes[, `:=`(
  annual_max_tmax_difference = hom_annual_max_tmax - raw_annual_max_tmax,
  annual_min_tmin_difference = hom_annual_min_tmin - raw_annual_min_tmin
)]

annual_extreme_summary <- rbindlist(list(
  annual_extremes[!is.na(annual_max_tmax_difference), .(
    statistic = "Annual maximum Tmax",
    n_station_years = .N,
    mean_difference = mean(annual_max_tmax_difference),
    median_difference = median(annual_max_tmax_difference),
    q05 = quantile(annual_max_tmax_difference, .05),
    q95 = quantile(annual_max_tmax_difference, .95),
    maximum_absolute_difference = max(abs(annual_max_tmax_difference)),
    proportion_changed = mean(abs(annual_max_tmax_difference) > 1e-10)
  )],
  annual_extremes[!is.na(annual_min_tmin_difference), .(
    statistic = "Annual minimum Tmin",
    n_station_years = .N,
    mean_difference = mean(annual_min_tmin_difference),
    median_difference = median(annual_min_tmin_difference),
    q05 = quantile(annual_min_tmin_difference, .05),
    q95 = quantile(annual_min_tmin_difference, .95),
    maximum_absolute_difference = max(abs(annual_min_tmin_difference)),
    proportion_changed = mean(abs(annual_min_tmin_difference) > 1e-10)
  )]
))

annual_extreme_summary
```

## Record identity

This comparison asks whether raw and homogenised streams identify the same date as the station record. Ties are retained.

```{r}
#| label: record-comparison

raw_tmax_records <- comparison[!is.na(tmax_raw),
  .SD[tmax_raw == max(tmax_raw)],
  by = .(acorn_station_number, station_name)
][, .(acorn_station_number, raw_record_date = date, raw_record_tmax = tmax_raw)]

hom_tmax_records <- comparison[!is.na(tmax_hom),
  .SD[tmax_hom == max(tmax_hom)],
  by = .(acorn_station_number, station_name)
][, .(acorn_station_number, hom_record_date = date, hom_record_tmax = tmax_hom)]

record_date_overlap <- merge(
  raw_tmax_records,
  hom_tmax_records,
  by = "acorn_station_number",
  allow.cartesian = TRUE
)[, .(
  same_record_date = any(raw_record_date == hom_record_date),
  raw_record_tmax = max(raw_record_tmax),
  hom_record_tmax = max(hom_record_tmax)
), by = acorn_station_number]

record_date_overlap[, .(
  stations = .N,
  same_record_date = sum(same_record_date),
  different_record_date = sum(!same_record_date)
)]
```

# Paired trend sensitivity

Annual extremes are used for the initial paired trend comparison. A station requires at least 30 years with both raw and homogenised annual statistics.

```{r}
#| label: trend-functions

fit_paired_trends <- function(data, raw_column, hom_column, minimum_years = 30L) {
  raw_column <- substitute(raw_column)
  hom_column <- substitute(hom_column)

  data[, {
    raw_value <- eval(raw_column)
    hom_value <- eval(hom_column)
    keep <- !is.na(raw_value) & !is.na(hom_value)

    if (sum(keep) < minimum_years) {
      list(
        n_years = sum(keep),
        raw_slope_per_decade = NA_real_,
        hom_slope_per_decade = NA_real_,
        slope_difference_per_decade = NA_real_
      )
    } else {
      raw_fit <- lm(raw_value[keep] ~ year[keep])
      hom_fit <- lm(hom_value[keep] ~ year[keep])
      raw_slope <- unname(coef(raw_fit)[2]) * 10
      hom_slope <- unname(coef(hom_fit)[2]) * 10

      list(
        n_years = sum(keep),
        raw_slope_per_decade = raw_slope,
        hom_slope_per_decade = hom_slope,
        slope_difference_per_decade = hom_slope - raw_slope
      )
    }
  }, by = .(acorn_station_number, station_name)]
}

trend_tmax <- fit_paired_trends(
  annual_extremes,
  raw_annual_max_tmax,
  hom_annual_max_tmax
)

trend_tmin <- fit_paired_trends(
  annual_extremes,
  raw_annual_min_tmin,
  hom_annual_min_tmin
)
```

```{r}
#| label: trend-summary

trend_summary <- rbindlist(list(
  trend_tmax[!is.na(slope_difference_per_decade), .(
    statistic = "Annual maximum Tmax",
    stations = .N,
    median_raw_slope = median(raw_slope_per_decade),
    median_hom_slope = median(hom_slope_per_decade),
    median_slope_difference = median(slope_difference_per_decade),
    q05_slope_difference = quantile(slope_difference_per_decade, .05),
    q95_slope_difference = quantile(slope_difference_per_decade, .95)
  )],
  trend_tmin[!is.na(slope_difference_per_decade), .(
    statistic = "Annual minimum Tmin",
    stations = .N,
    median_raw_slope = median(raw_slope_per_decade),
    median_hom_slope = median(hom_slope_per_decade),
    median_slope_difference = median(slope_difference_per_decade),
    q05_slope_difference = quantile(slope_difference_per_decade, .05),
    q95_slope_difference = quantile(slope_difference_per_decade, .95)
  )]
))

trend_summary
```

```{r}
#| label: trend-plot
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5

trend_plot_data <- rbindlist(list(
  trend_tmax[, .(
    statistic = "Annual maximum Tmax",
    slope_difference_per_decade
  )],
  trend_tmin[, .(
    statistic = "Annual minimum Tmin",
    slope_difference_per_decade
  )]
), use.names = TRUE)

trend_plot_data <- trend_plot_data[!is.na(slope_difference_per_decade)]

ggplot(trend_plot_data,
       aes(slope_difference_per_decade, fill = statistic)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ statistic, scales = "free_y") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Change in estimated linear trend after homogenisation",
    subtitle = "Homogenised slope minus raw slope",
    x = "Slope difference (°C per decade)", y = "Stations"
  )
```

```{r}

station_adjustments <- comparison[, .(
  matched_tmax = sum(matched_tmax),
  mean_tmax_adjustment = mean(tmax_adjustment, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_tmax_adjustment = median(tmax_adjustment, na.rm = TRUE),

  mean_tmin_adjustment = mean(tmin_adjustment, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_tmin_adjustment = median(tmin_adjustment, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd_tmin_adjustment = sd(tmin_adjustment, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_abs_tmin_adjustment = max(abs(tmin_adjustment), na.rm = TRUE),
  proportion_tmin_changed = mean(abs(tmin_adjustment) > 1e-10, na.rm = TRUE)
), by = .(acorn_station_number, station_name)]

station_adjustments[order(-abs(mean_tmax_adjustment))]
station_adjustments[order(-abs(mean_tmin_adjustment))]
```

```{r}
fwrite(adjustment_by_raw_quantile, file.path(output_dir, "adjustments_by_raw_temperature_quantile.csv"))
fwrite(annual_extreme_summary, file.path(output_dir, "annual_extreme_summary.csv"))
fwrite(trend_summary, file.path(output_dir, "trend_summary.csv"))
fwrite(station_adjustments, file.path(output_dir, "station_adjustment_summary.csv"))
fwrite(largest_tmax, file.path(output_dir, "largest_tmax_adjustments.csv"))
fwrite(largest_tmin, file.path(output_dir, "largest_tmin_adjustments.csv"))
```

# Interpretation framework

The report should be interpreted in the following order:

1. **Coverage:** determine whether raw and homogenised records are being compared over the same station-days.
2. **Central adjustments:** quantify typical adjustment direction and magnitude.
3. **Tail adjustments:** inspect the rare large corrections separately from the bulk distribution.
4. **Temperature dependence:** test whether adjustment magnitude changes systematically towards hot or cold tails.
5. **Extreme statistics:** quantify whether annual maxima, annual minima and record identities change.
6. **Trend sensitivity:** compare raw and homogenised trends using identical paired years.
7. **Spatial dependence:** undertake only after the marginal and trend effects above are understood.

# Limitations and next analysis

This initial report uses linear trends in annual extremes as a transparent baseline, not as the final model of climate non-stationarity. Subsequent analysis should examine threshold exceedance rates, persistence, changepoints, non-stationary extreme-value models and raw-versus-homogenised spatial tail dependence.

The largest individual daily adjustments should also be cross-referenced against the ACORN adjustment-summary and transfer-function metadata before being characterised as unusual or erroneous.
